skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators by renaming them with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers or whole numbers by separating whole and fractional parts when no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Regroup or rename whole numbers or mixed numbers, including improper fractional parts, when borrowing or normalization is needed before subtracting.
